import hashlib,json,struct,zlib
from pathlib import Path
boards=[
("Water Droplet Companion.png","d232af73adeb2e9d4673ced04269f73a5d84a06d",2109568),
("Water Droplet Companion Expression.png","f11033572cd43634be1c5a6451f5d172989c17a8",2179910),
("Water Droplet Companion Animation.png","dbeabf0c00b58f5ef1e32a5f86016fbd1e71881a",1896556),
("Water Droplet Companion Animation Plus.png","01d76718c365fe675359b3bfc9e5b303bbacaff6",1930250)]
out=[]
for name,expected_blob,expected_bytes in boards:
    file=Path("assets")/name
    if not file.is_file() or file.is_symlink():
        raise SystemExit("REFERENCE_ASSET_IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED")
    raw=file.read_bytes()
    git_blob=hashlib.sha1(("blob "+str(len(raw))+"\0").encode("ascii")+raw).hexdigest()
    if len(raw)!=expected_bytes or git_blob!=expected_blob:
        raise SystemExit("REFERENCE_GIT_BLOB_OR_SIZE_MISMATCH")
    if len(raw)<33 or raw[:8]!=b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" or raw[8:12]!=b"\0\0\0\r" or raw[12:16]!=b"IHDR":
        raise SystemExit("REFERENCE_INVALID_PNG_HEADER")
    crc=struct.unpack(">I",raw[29:33])[0]
    if (zlib.crc32(raw[12:29]) & 0xffffffff)!=crc:
        raise SystemExit("REFERENCE_IHDR_CRC_FAILURE")
    width,height=struct.unpack(">II",raw[16:24])
    if not(100<=width<=16000 and 100<=height<=16000):
        raise SystemExit("REFERENCE_DIMENSIONS_OUT_OF_RANGE")
    out.append({"file":"assets/"+name,"git_blob":git_blob,"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"width":width,"height":height,"bit_depth":raw[24],"color_type":raw[25]})
print(json.dumps({"schema":1,"source":"immutable-tracked-assets","original_png_pixels_inspected":False,"assets":out},sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")))
